intent: Added a sixth sensor to extend coverage beyond current tape edges to reduce line loss and off-track events on the slalom track, while slightly reducing wheel track to 0.15 m to improve agility and control. Maintained sensor size at 0.016 m and body width at 0.16 m for coverage and stability. Expect fewer line loss events, improved line detection at edges, and better overall track completion and error metrics.
rationale: The previous iteration extended sensor positions further to the tape edges with a 5-sensor layout, sensor size 0.016 m, and wheel track/body width at 0.16 m, improving stability but still failing to complete the slalom track due to off-track terminations and line loss at tape edges. Telemetry and integrator feedback indicate that sensor coverage at the tape edges remains insufficient, causing line loss and control challenges. To address this, I propose adding a sixth sensor positioned beyond the current outer sensors to cover blind spots at the tape edges, while slightly reducing the wheel track to 0.15 m to improve agility and potentially reduce max error and steering oscillation. Sensor size remains at 0.016 m to maintain good coverage, and body width stays at 0.16 m for off-track tolerance. Wheel radius and body length remain unchanged to preserve speed and agility. I expect this geometry to reduce line loss events and off-track terminations on the slalom track, improve line detection at tape edges, and enhance overall performance and completion rates across all tracks.
